added_failures_note: Completed source suite arms: baseline 1 failed and 6 passed; head 7 passed; head-minus-baseline failure ids are empty.

assertion_audit.scripts/prototypes/efit_field_swap/test_: Fails if fitted capacity still yields no valid contour vertex.

Independent JT-60SA record must read limited with winding and admitted index one, a positive number of cleared cells and zero uncleared cells; reverting coverage admission to a refusal or skipping enclosure reddens the corresponding line.
assertion_audit.scripts/prototypes/tcv_liuqe_known_answe: A census that admits both extrema but misses the saddle must refuse, return no resolution, carry an uncertified certificate and disagree with the boundary index; reverting the refusal or the index comparison reddens a check.
The known field must have winding one and a boundary gradient above its floor; corrupting either measured value reddens the check.

A census that misses an extremum-saddle pair in empty cells must refuse despite equal boundary and admitted indices, leave no resolution, count an uncleared cell and remain uncertified; skipping the empty-cell exclusion reddens line 146 in the recorded negative control.
A constant zero-gradient cell must be neither cleared nor occupied and must remain unresolved; treating its flat gradient as a strict sign reddens these checks.
An invalid axis slot must refuse and name failed axis admission; treating an invalid root as sufficient reddens the label, resolution, certificate or attempt check.
A true one-maximum field must certify with admitted index one and read limited; an overbroad refusal or changed index rule reddens a check.

The analytic annular domain has nonzero equal outer and obstacle windings, total zero and a certified index; adding obstacle winding, failing to measure it or refusing the valid domain reddens a check.
A stationary point on a boundary loop must make winding unreliable and uncertified; trusting the sampled zero reddens both checks.
The chosen LIUQE slice must have no stored X-point and must return a certified limited read with zero uncleared cells; changing the selected input or a refusal regression reddens a check.

The independent square outline makes the axis-to-boundary span 0.5 m and the synthetic 0.1 m axis gap relative 0.2, with no X-distance for a limited case; reverting the old X-distance denominator or fabricating an absent X-distance reddens a check.
The analytic two-maximum, one-saddle field must wind once; changing the field winding or accepting an index sum of two reddens these checks.

findings.text: blocking: Any cell containing one admitted root is skipped by the Bernstein exclusion; an additional missed extremum-saddle pair in that cell preserves the boundary index sum and can be labelled coverage certified, contrary to the report's completeness claim and without a test that would fail.

follow-on: The summary pairs independently maximized absolute and relative flux gaps as though they came from one slice; the report table shows the largest boundary gap 0.1085 at slice 46 has relative gap 0.911, while 2.482 belongs to slice 0.
